Per-patient rank disagreement across propensity models

Source: R/rank_disagreement.R
rank_disagreement.Rd

For each patient, d is the standard deviation over the models in use of the percentile rank r_m(i) = rank(logit_m(i)) / n. The decomposition separates disagreement between algorithms from seed noise within an algorithm: d_between is the standard deviation over algorithms of the per-algorithm mean rank, and d_within is the square root of the mean over algorithms with at least two seeds of the variance over seeds (NA when no algorithm has two seeds). A ratio d_between / d_within near 1 means the algorithms disagree with themselves as much as with each other: noise, not model dependence. d_logit, the standard deviation of the logits, is the secondary logit-scale version; calibration differences inflate it without changing who is near whom. Standard deviations use the n - 1 denominator.

Usage

rank_disagreement(model_set, use_gate = TRUE, models = NULL)

# S3 method for class 'rank_disagreement'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

model_set

A propensity_model_set from fit_propensity_models().

use_gate

TRUE (default) to use the models that passed the log-loss gate; FALSE to use every model.

models

Optional character vector of model ids to use instead of a gate; it overrides use_gate. The wrapper propensity_sensitivity() passes the final quality-gate set (log-loss and balance) this way.

x

A rank_disagreement object.

...

Not used.

Value

An object of class "rank_disagreement": a list with patients (one row per patient: row, treated, rank_disagreement, rank_disagreement_between, rank_disagreement_within, logit_disagreement), summary (mean_d_treated, mean_d_all, median_between_within_ratio_treated, mean_d_logit_treated), models_used, quality_gate_left_fewer_than_two_models and settings.

Quality gate

With use_gate = TRUE only the models that passed the log-loss gate are used. If fewer than two passed, all models are used and quality_gate_left_fewer_than_two_models is TRUE . The flag reports the gate's outcome whatever use_gate is.

Examples

data("lalonde", package = "MatchIt")
model_set <- fit_propensity_models(
  treat ~ age + educ + race + married + nodegree + re74 + re75,
  data = lalonde, seeds = 1:2, n_trees = 100,
  algorithms = c("logistic_regression", "random_forest", "gradient_boosting")
)
disagreement <- rank_disagreement(model_set)
disagreement
#> Rank disagreement: 4 model(s) in use (after the log-loss gate)
#> Mean d over treated: 0.02894; over all patients: 0.0445
#> Median d_between / d_within over treated: 3.522 (near 1 = seed noise, not model dependence)
#> Mean d_logit over treated: 0.4483
head(disagreement$patients)
